description: EAST HAVEN - East Haven State Representative Joe Zullo (R, 99) announced today that he has filed the official paperwork with the Connecticut State Elections Enforcement Commission and intends to seek re-election to the 99th assembly district seat representing the majority of the Town of East Haven in the November 3, 2026 election.
